column1: # drill-costs.tsv — per-drill launch costs, used ONLY for launch ORDERING (V1).
# WHY. run-drills.sh launched drills in LEXICOGRAPHIC order. On 2026-07-23 that put the single longest
# drill (96-mid-flight-chaos, 22.2 min) at position 37 of 38, starting at minute 25 of a 47.4-minute
# sweep. Longest-processing-time-first drops the wall to max(sum/j, longest) with no change to what any
# drill does: wall 47.4 -> ~32.5 min at -j 6 (= max(sum/j, p_max) = max(195.1/6, 22.3)), purely from
# the order things start in — ~15 min recovered from the alphabetical tail.
# THIS FILE CANNOT AFFECT A VERDICT. It is consulted for sort order only. A stale or wrong cost can
# mis-order a sweep; it can never mis-judge one. A drill ABSENT from this table sorts FIRST at maximum
# cost, so a newly added drill can never silently become the straggler that sets the wall.
# Measured costs are ONE sample each (n=1; the column used to be called p50_secs, which it never was).
# S5 final rows have one COMPLETE serial quiet-window sample per unit. Re-seed from a
# sweep's rollup.tsv duration_s column (run-drills.sh records it) — from COMPLETE runs: a run that died at an
# early assertion (a SETUP-RED at a watermark, an ASSERT-FAIL before the long phase) under-measures the unit.
# Source: S2 full sweep -j 6 (lanes on, cap 5, --no-retry), weilandserver, 2026-09-19 21:08:04–21:36:39 (sweep phase 1719 s; the attribution pass ran to 22:10), simcluster-speed
# image #11 (a3431a1 + the increment). One sample per UNIT (arm units of 74/96 carry their own rows); attribution
# solo re-runs excluded. Class: short <=180, medium 181–500, long >500 (the July bands, unchanged). 78/83/84 had no
# row before (they sorted first at max cost since they landed); the interim solo-2026-09-19 rows are replaced.
# 2026-09-20 round-2 review R1-F9: eight S2 first-attempt rows came from NON-completing runs (98 SETUP-RED at the
# watermark = 186 s vs ≈245 s complete; 94 191 s pre-#87 ASSERT-FAIL; 52/60/81/73/30/96.F ASSERT-FAIL first attempts).
# Those rows are re-seeded here from the nearest COMPLETE sample on the same or a later image (batch21 solos / V7 -j12 /
# the round-2 re-runs), noted per row. Order-only file: the effect is a slot or two.
